title: Doctoral Fellowships
summary: Fellowships for particularly qualified junior doctoral candidates in historical studies to conduct research at the Herzog August Library in Wolfenbüttel, Germany, for 2 to 10 months.

degree_levels.notes: Junior doctoral candidates/PhD students are eligible.

institutions.notes: Research must be centred on the Herzog August Library during the stay.

nationality.notes: Countries explicitly listed in the selection dropdown.

residence.notes: Applicants from Germany and abroad are eligible; country dropdown and residency condition apply.

mandatory.text: Doctoral candidate from an area of historical study
Library's holdings must be essential for research
Demonstrated outstanding competence in academic or scientific work

funding.description: 1,300 EUR per month (increased by 150 EUR per month until further notice due to additional funding). Rent is to be paid from the scholarship funds. Allowance for material expenses of 100 EUR per month. Contribution to travel expenses if they cannot be borne by a third party.

application_rounds.notes: 1 April and 1 October of each year

recurring_deadline_notes: 1 April and 1 October of each year

sources.title: Herzog August Bibliothek: Doctoral Fellowships - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: Supports international doctoral candidates conducting research physically in Germany at the Herzog August Library.
